# NameBright DNS
> Managed DNS service by NameBright for hosting, configuring, and controlling domain DNS records.

NameBright DNS provides DNS management for domains registered with NameBright, including nameserver configuration, DNS record editing, domain forwarding, and account-based domain administration.

## Main Site
- [NameBright DNS Home](https://namebrightdns.com/): Main landing page for NameBright DNS domain and DNS management services.
- [NameBright](https://www.namebright.com/): Parent registrar platform for domain registration, account access, and domain administration.
- [Login](https://www.namebright.com/Login): Account login for managing domains, DNS settings, and related services.
- [Register Domains](https://www.namebright.com/): Domain search and registration entry point on the NameBright platform.

## DNS Management
- [DNS Management](https://www.namebright.com/DNS): Central interface for viewing and editing DNS settings for managed domains.
- [Nameservers](https://www.namebright.com/DNS/Nameservers): Configure authoritative nameservers for domains managed through NameBright.
- [DNS Records](https://www.namebright.com/DNS/Records): Manage common DNS records such as A, AAAA, MX, CNAME, TXT, and SRV.
- [Domain Forwarding](https://www.namebright.com/DNS/Forwarding): Configure URL forwarding and redirection behavior for domains.
- [Email Forwarding](https://www.namebright.com/DNS/EmailForwarding): Set up email forwarding rules associated with managed domains.

## Domain Administration
- [My Domains](https://www.namebright.com/MyAccount/Domains): View and manage domains in the current NameBright account.
- [Domain Details](https://www.namebright.com/MyAccount/Domains): Access registration, DNS, renewal, and ownership settings for individual domains.
- [Contact Information](https://www.namebright.com/MyAccount/Contacts): Manage registrant, administrative, billing, and technical contact records.
- [Auto Renew](https://www.namebright.com/MyAccount/Domains): Review and configure automatic renewal preferences for domains.
- [Domain Transfers](https://www.namebright.com/Transfer): Start inbound domain transfers to the NameBright registrar platform.

## Account and Security
- [Account Overview](https://www.namebright.com/MyAccount): Main account area for domains, billing, and profile management.
- [Profile Settings](https://www.namebright.com/MyAccount/Profile): Update account profile information and account preferences.
- [Payment Methods](https://www.namebright.com/MyAccount/PaymentMethods): Manage saved payment methods used for registrations and renewals.
- [Order History](https://www.namebright.com/MyAccount/Orders): Review historical orders and account purchase activity.
- [Security Settings](https://www.namebright.com/MyAccount/Security): Manage account security controls and authentication-related settings.

## Support
- [Support Center](https://www.namebright.com/Support): Entry point for customer support resources and assistance.
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.namebright.com/Support): Help resources for common domain and DNS management tasks.
- [Contact Support](https://www.namebright.com/Support): Reach NameBright support for account, billing, and DNS issues.
- [Forgot Password](https://www.namebright.com/ForgotPassword): Recover access to a NameBright account using password reset tools.

## Domain Services
- [WHOIS Lookup](https://www.namebright.com/Whois): Search public registration data for domain names.
- [Domain Transfer](https://www.namebright.com/Transfer): Transfer existing domains into a NameBright account.
- [Expired Domains](https://www.namebright.com/ExpiredDomains): Browse expired domain inventory and related auction opportunities.
- [Domain Search](https://www.namebright.com/): Search availability for new domain registrations.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://www.namebright.com/Terms): Legal terms governing use of NameBright services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.namebright.com/Privacy): Privacy practices for account, registration, and service data.
- [ICANN Information](https://www.namebright.com/ICANN): Registrar-related ICANN disclosures and domain registration information.
- [Registrant Rights and Responsibilities](https://www.namebright.com/RegistrantRights): Summary of registrant obligations and protections.
- [Abuse Contact](https://www.namebright.com/Abuse): Report abuse or review abuse reporting contact information.
